source_split: CIFAR10 test only; no candidate or reference from CIFAR10 train
partition_rule: existing reference + first 1000 of predeclared shuffled Dev form new reference; remaining Dev stays Dev; Hidden unchanged
fixed_representation: official checkpoint logits, no further training or representation change

primary_metric.name: mean_case_method_seconds
primary_metric.aggregation: median of 9 independent fresh method invocations per case; mean of six cases per seed; arithmetic mean over all five seeds

timing_scope: method invocation including all label geometry, couplings, potentials and aggregation; excludes common feature extraction, input deserialization and dependency import; process and end-to-end wall times separately logged

score.upper_bound_source: metric_ceiling: nonnegative elapsed method time has mathematical infimum zero; not derived from R; no clipping

significance_rule: R positive improvement >=3 times Baseline n-1 sample standard deviation across all formal seeds; R score in [.15,.8]
